diagrams.what_it_represents: 36 small schematic line-drawings, one per shape code, each showing a bar's centreline shape (straight, single bend, U, Z-crank, closed link, helix, etc.) with dimension letters A-E annotated on the relevant segments and, where relevant, a radius arrow labelled r or R.
diagrams.cad_recreation_notes: Each schematic is recreatable as a 2D polyline (straight segments) with arc segments at each bend (arc radius = r from Table B.1, or explicit R). Dimension letters correspond 1:1 to segment lengths or arc-related offsets per the field list in 06_drawing_conventions.json. Link shapes (41,44,46,47,51,56,63,64) are closed or near-closed rectangular polylines representing stirrup/link cross-sections. Shape 75/77 are circles/helices (circular arc or 3D helix respectively) rather than polylines.
diagrams.fact_status: INFERRED geometry from the textual shape descriptions and formulas — the actual line-art was not transcribable from this text-extracted source; only the associated formulas, dimension-letter sets, and constraint notes are DIRECTLY STATED.

diagrams.what_it_represents: A small header diagram showing a single bend with 'r' (internal radius) and '5d' / 'P' end-projection labelled, illustrating what r, M (bending former diameter = 2r), and P mean physically.
diagrams.cad_recreation_notes: Single arc of radius r, with a straight tangent leg of length P leaving the bend, tick-marked '5d' near the free end to show the minimum straight portion.

diagrams.what_it_represents: An L-shaped bar (90-degree hook) with a labelled 5d lead-in segment and a labelled 'Mandrel dia.' arc, illustrating the effective_anchorage_length_L_bars formula/table.
A U-shaped bar (180-degree hook) with a labelled 5d lead-in and 'Mandrel dia.' arc, illustrating the effective_anchorage_length_U_bars formula/table.
A 'Hook' end-detail: straight bar with 5d lead-in bending through dimension B (the mandrel diameter) at fy=500MPa, referencing the minimum_overall_depth_U_bar_end_shapes.hook_shape table.

A 'Trombone' end-detail: straight bar, 5d lead-in, a 4d offset segment (4øB per label), then bend through dimension B (mandrel diameter), referencing minimum_overall_depth_U_bar_end_shapes.trombone_shape table.

diagrams_referenced_but_not_reproduced_n.location: Appendix B, pp.183-188, repeated per concrete class
diagrams_referenced_but_not_reproduced_n.what_it_represents: A bend-in-a-slab/beam schematic showing Fbt (tensile force arrow), ab (half bar spacing or cover+b/2), and b (bar diameter) as the inputs to the bm_min formula.
diagrams_referenced_but_not_reproduced_n.status: Formula and variable meanings are DIRECTLY STATED (see 03_detailing_rules.json); the six large numeric tables that follow each diagram are treated as DERIVED (computable from the formula) rather than transcribed — see large_diameter_bends_minimum_mandrel_size in 03_detailing_rules.json for the rationale.
